title: Ashbury Rewards Co-Brand Card Benefit Guide: Card Credits on Award Stays
content:
Cardmembers of the Ashbury Rewards co-brand cards receive card credits — elite night credits — on each Ashbury Rewards award stay, a completed Reward Night Rate stay credited to the membership, when the card is in active use.

## Benefit terms

A member whose linked co-brand card is the Ashbury Rewards Premier card and whose account shows at least six co-brand card points transactions posted in the twelve months before the handling date receives two card credits on the award stay; a member whose linked card is the Ashbury Rewards card and whose account shows at least six such transactions receives one card credit; any other member receives no card credit. The card credits are added to the night credits posted for the award stay, and they are credits the award stay is owed, never an excess over its nights stayed.

The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date. The transactions counted are the co-brand card points the card issuer posts with each statement; the linked card is the co-brand card shown on the membership.

## Benefit table

| Linked co-brand card | Co-brand card points transactions in the twelve months | Card credits on the award stay |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 6 or more | 2 |
| Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 5 or fewer | None |
| Ashbury Rewards card | 6 or more | 1 |
| Ashbury Rewards card | 5 or fewer | None |
| No co-brand card | any | None |

## The twelve-month count (hypothetical handling date of 6 October 2026)

| Posted date of a co-brand card points transaction | Counted |
|---|---|
| 6 October 2025 | No — not after the same day number twelve months earlier |
| 7 October 2025 | Yes |
| 6 October 2026 | Yes — the handling date itself is included |

A Premier cardmember whose account shows exactly 6 co-brand card points transactions in that window receives 2 card credits; with 5 such transactions, none.
